theorem bbolt.fileHolds.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (i i✝ :
    Fs.Ino) (e_i : i = i✝) (D D✝ : bbolt.Data) (e_D : D = D✝) : bbolt.fileHolds i D =
    bbolt.fileHolds i✝ D✝

    bbolt.DB.Begin_err.spec) (hCommit : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk]
    [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.Tx.Commit_err.spec) (hClose : bbolt.DB.Close.spec) (hclose : ∀
    [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt],
    bbolt.DB.close.spec_owned) (hLogger : bbolt.DB.Logger.spec) (hOptStr :
    bbolt.Options.String.spec) (hModeStr : bbolt.fs.FileMode.String.spec) : bbolt.Open_shared.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Open_shared.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt] [ThreadBoundLe GF (2 ^ 29)]
    [ReceiptBoundLe GF (2 ^ 62)] (N : Namespace) (R : Fs.Roots) (d b : GoString) (dq : DFrac) (j : Fs.Ino) (qc : Qp)
    (h : Fs.NamesH) (mode : w32) (opts : Loc) (dqo : DFrac) (o : bbolt.OptsM) (D : bbolt.Data),
    NameOk b →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt ∗
              Fs.osInv ∗
                ⌜N ## Fs.osN⌝ ∗
                  Fs.osSharedInv R ∗
                    Fs.osPathS R d dq j ∗
                      Fs.osCallPerm qc ∗
                        Fs.osNames j (Fs.NameSet.only [b]) (DFrac.own 1) h ∗
                          bbolt.nameHolds h b D ∗
                            bbolt.optsAt opts dqo o ∗
                              ⌜o.ok⌝ ∗ (⌜o.logger = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ bbolt.boltLogger o.logger) -∗
            (▷
                ∀ db err,
                  (bbolt.optsAt opts dqo o ∗
                      Fs.osPathS R d dq j ∗
                        Fs.osCallPerm qc ∗
                          ∃ oc,
                            crOut j b h (DFrac.own 1) oc ∗
                              ((⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                  ∃ γ i, ⌜γ.ns = N ∧ crIno b h oc i⌝ ∗ bbolt.isBolt db γ ∗ bbolt.boltState γ 1 D) ∨
                                ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝)) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal db, intoVal err)) -∗
              WP
                ((((intoVal (functions go_etcd_io.bbolt.Open [])) (intoVal (Fs.child d b))) (intoVal mode))
                  (intoVal opts))
                {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.nameHolds.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (h h✝ :
    Fs.NamesH) (e_h : h = h✝) (b b✝ : GoString) (e_b : b = b✝) (D D✝ : bbolt.Data) (e_D : D = D✝) :
    bbolt.nameHolds h b D = bbolt.nameHolds h✝ b✝ D✝

theorem crMeta.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (a✝ a✝¹ : Option (Nat × Nat ×
    Fs.Ino)) : a✝ = a✝¹ → crMeta a✝ = crMeta a✝¹
